summary: Implemented the refactor in the repository without running tests or code, and without committing. New ignite-free modules: monai/handlers/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), monai/handlers/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver), and monai/handlers/plot_2d_or_3d_image.py (plot_2d_or_3d_image). SegmentationSaver now delegates to NiftiSaver, ClassificationSaver delegates to CSVSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler._add_2_or_3_d delegates to plot_2d_or_3d_image, keeping public APIs unchanged. Added unit tests: tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py. Updated docs/source/handlers.rst. Known pre-existing quirks were preserved: SegmentationSaver ignores its dtype argument, and the 3D non-RGB branch returns after the first channel. Tests have not been run and are unverified.
